name: nexus-terminal

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.format:spacing: eslint --fix packages/backend/src packages/shared/src packages/frontend/src tests scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:spacing:check: eslint --cache --cache-strategy content packages/backend/src packages/shared/src packages/frontend/src tests scripts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:all: pnpm run format:spacing && prettier --write "{packages,tests,scripts,doc,.github}/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,cjs,json,css,md,vue,yml,yaml}" package.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:all:check: pnpm run format:spacing:check && prettier --cache --cache-strategy content --check "{packages,tests,scripts,doc,.github}/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,cjs,json,css,md,vue,yml,yaml}" package.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run lint:backend
scripts.test:all: pnpm run check && pnpm --filter @nexus-terminal/tests build && pnpm --filter @nexus-terminal/tests test:fast && pnpm --filter @nexus-terminal/tests test:integration && pnpm --filter @nexus-terminal/tests test:e2e

description: Unified build entry points for Nexus Terminal
